SEARCH
Package neqsim.thermo.characterization

Class RefineryHydrotreatingHydrogenSupplyBalance

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.characterization.RefineryHydrotreatingHydrogenSupplyBalance
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class RefineryHydrotreatingHydrogenSupplyBalance extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable makeup-gas and outlet-gas material balance for a hydrotreating screening case.

The calculation composes a RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurBalance with explicit hydrogen purity, excess supply, and non-hydrogen molar-mass assumptions. It does not predict reaction kinetics, phase equilibrium, recycle behavior, catalyst performance, or operating conditions.

  • Method Details

    • calculate

      public static RefineryHydrotreatingHydrogenSupplyBalance calculate(RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurBalance sulfurBalance, double hydrogenSupplyFactor, double makeupHydrogenMoleFraction, double nonHydrogenMolarMassKgPerMol)
      Calculate the makeup-gas and outlet-gas material balance.
      Parameters:
      sulfurBalance - qualified sulfur-removal receipt to compose without mutation
      hydrogenSupplyFactor - moles of hydrogen supplied per mole consumed; at least one
      makeupHydrogenMoleFraction - hydrogen mole fraction in makeup gas, in (0, 1]
      nonHydrogenMolarMassKgPerMol - average molar mass of the non-hydrogen makeup fraction
      Returns:
      immutable gas-supply balance receipt
